note: Block 1024 instead of 2048, on the winning gate+untie stack. Throughput is the dominant axis (arm 10), and attention is ~11% of FLOPs at block 2048 -- halving the sequence should cut that, ease the 92.2% HBM, and let SDPA run a cheaper kernel. a4.0 production trained at 1024, so this is also a real production choice rather than an import. Held constant deliberately: micro_batch 8->16 keeps effective batch at 245,760 AND keeps rows-per-micro-step at 16,384, so the logit transient is byte-identical and only the sequence length varies. Eval still runs at 2048/4096/8192, so a 1024-trained model is judged on its ability to EXTRAPOLATE to the same contexts as everything else.
